description: Asks what Round returns for the number of digits and the operand type: half-way values at several digit counts (including negative and out-of-range counts), values whose decimal form is a half but whose binary form is not, Currency, Decimal and Single operands, text and Boolean operands, and non-integer digit counts. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr, VarType(expr), TypeName(expr) FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
